{{Quote|That's me &ndash; Trooper Anson Trask &ndash; ten days out of training and green as bantha butter.|Anson Trask talking as he joined [[Joker Squad]] on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]|<ref name="Legacy 4" />}}
'''Bantha butter''' was a sweet, creamy [[Butter/Legends|butter]]. It was [[Color/Legends|green]] in coloration<ref name="Legacy 4" /> and smooth<ref name="Mindor" /> and thick in texture. The butter could turn rancid<ref name="Soup's On" /> and be sliced through easily.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>

The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] included bantha butter in several menu items that were served<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> prior to the diner's destruction in [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] or [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' established that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later stated that the novel took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], so Dex's Diner was destroyed either during 19 BBY or 18 BBY.</ref>
